title: Unit Review: Norm and Correctness in Writing
goal: Review que and de que, se, the gerund, tenses in formal reports and double participles in formal writing.
grammar: Unit Review: Norm and Correctness in Writing

items: I can choose between *que* and *de que*, and keep *se* and the gerund within the written norm.
I can report requests with the right subjunctive and use the right participle in formal prose.
I can use the vocabulary of editing, style and committees to correct a text.
